entries.reason: the property iOS 10 added to the synthesizer, carried as a category in AVFoundation/AVSpeechSynthesizer10.m: 6.1.3's VSSpeechSynthesizer has no per-channel routing (its selectors are in facts/AVFoundation/AVSpeech.md), so nothing on this release acts on the value
entries.effect: the value the caller set, nil on a fresh synthesizer as the header's default says, held per synthesizer and read back as it was given (an empty array reads back empty, nil reads back nil, the host's AVAudioSessionChannelDescription array reads back as the same array). Nothing on 6.1.3 routes speech to the channels
entries.source: SDK 16.4, AVFAudio (AVSpeechSynthesis.h); tests/backports/host/avf-speech/synth-checks.m, the host's own class against the port's
